scope: A separately bounded continuation after independently accepted100/183. Prior science, policies, inputs and ZIPs are immutable; public development results do not certify official rank.

execution.before_each_measurement: Freeze plan, exact implementation/settings/source/input manifests and meaningful synthetic/counterfactual fixtures and test receipt before any benchmark call; notify independent auditor. Preserve all failures and aborts.

label_boundary.predictor_inputs: Only official state/model/questions, raw supplied records and label descriptions. Internal normalization must match pinned server validator.
forbidden: Expected answers or labels from evaluator
Evaluation task IDs/hash/query-to-answer or query-to-rank tables
Inference reads of benchmark task/gold/evaluation result files
Hardcoded public entity-to-outcome mapping or test sentence matching
label_boundary.allowed_adaptation: Observed public development errors may motivate general algorithm changes, declared as adaptive. They cannot certify generalization.
tests_before_scoring: Counterfactual supplied values/dates/cohort boundaries change derived decisions
Irrelevant narrative cannot override trusted explicit data
Unsupported required filters, ambiguous mapping, missing facts/cycles/empty cohorts abstain
Renamed exact label sets preserve semantic decisions without canonical-label assumptions

relation_mechanism.supported: Explicit typed source-linked relations, alias declarations, authority/provenance joins and effective-date precedence whose full applicable rules are supplied in normalized state/questions.
relation_mechanism.required_abstention: Missing edge, ambiguous alias/entity, conflicting provenance, unsupported syntax, cycle, absent or conflicting precedence, unknown operative condition or date ambiguity must retain immutable100.
relation_mechanism.required_proof: Every override has exact source offsets and parsed typed facts, alias and label mappings, full traversed edge path, all applicable predicates/date boundaries/precedence, and source-proven final label distribution. Auditor reconstructs every override independently from literal normalized inputs.
counterfactual_tests: Counterfactual dates on both sides of supplied effective boundaries

requirements: A fresh primary-source-supported official route and eligible package/configuration
Exact candidate/source identity and reproducible execution specification
Every public-development, comparison, latency and rank claim matches verified scope
No invented contact identity, account identity, sealed scores, Capability or institutional affiliation
Actual returned submission receipt/URL required to claim submission; draft/preparation alone is not submission
submission_review.official_full_coverage: Current JevBench matching1500/1200sealed publisher evaluation required for official placement; full162 LegalBench tasks remain separate from LegalBench-RAG.
